_metadata.description: Capture each supported source kind into a consistent artifact handed to the backup engine.

requirements.title: Filesystem source capture
requirements.description: Capture a filesystem path or glob, resolved storage-root-relative where possible for portability, and hand it to the kopia snapshot.

validation.notes: Snapshot a temp tree, restore, assert byte-identical.

requirements.title: SQLite source capture
requirements.description: Capture a SQLite database via a consistent VACUUM INTO snapshot rather than copying a live file.

validation.notes: Snapshot under concurrent writes; restore; assert integrity_check ok.

requirements.title: Postgres source capture
requirements.description: Capture a Postgres schema/database via the postgres resource CLI (pg_dump); the source resource owns its credential resolution and DBM never becomes a secret broker.

validation.notes: Dump a seeded schema, restore to a scratch schema, assert row equality.

requirements.title: Redis source capture (best-effort namespace)
requirements.description: Capture a Redis key namespace (scenario prefix) via SCAN+DUMP. Explicitly best-effort, not transactional point-in-time; this limit is documented.

validation.notes: Seed prefixed keys, capture, restore into clean instance, assert key/value equality.

requirements.title: Qdrant source capture
requirements.description: Capture a Qdrant collection via the snapshot API and restore by upload.

validation.notes: Snapshot a seeded collection, restore, assert point count and a sample vector match.

requirements.title: Object-storage source capture
requirements.description: Capture an object-storage bucket/prefix (MinIO/S3) by mirroring objects; shares the S3 SDK code used for object-storage destinations.

validation.notes: Mirror a seeded prefix, restore to a new prefix, assert object set + checksums.
